summary: PWP website build, visual, accessibility, Lighthouse, link, and staging flow checks passed. PDF mechanical/OCR baselines were rendered and accepted for controlled staging, but semantic image QA tooling was unavailable and the PDF does not yet strongly express the requested navy/gold premium HDE palette; final design approval remains tracked rather than green.

commands.screenshots_and_pwp: cd /home/ubuntu/work/hd-platform && npm run qa:update-screenshots && npm run pwp:verify

pwp_verify.a11y: 12 passed; no serious or critical axe violations
pwp_verify.flows_local: 6 passed, 4 skipped because staging env vars are intentionally absent during local verify
pwp_verify.lighthouse: 5 URLs processed; reports written to okf/output/pwp-visual-qa/lighthouse

pdf_baselines.semantic_image_qa: unavailable; vision tooling returned Cloudflare challenge HTML, so this is manual/OCR/mechanical proof, not final semantic design approval

manual_pdf_checklist.navy_gold_palette: partial; representative sampled colors skew purple/blue with no meaningful gold bucket; track stronger navy/gold HDE system before final brand approval
manual_pdf_checklist.typography: legible but generic; OCR title confusion suggests header/brand typography needs polish
manual_pdf_checklist.spacing: acceptable for controlled staging; page 2 dense gate/channel lists need more breathing room
manual_pdf_checklist.chart_clarity: summary facts readable; chart/art/header area needs semantic design review
manual_pdf_checklist.sanctuary_tone: calm explanatory tone; no fake companion behavior observed in OCR/manual text sample
manual_pdf_checklist.website_routes: PWP screenshots/a11y/Lighthouse/link checks passed for home, deconditioning, success, privacy, terms, academy routes

PDF is not yet a strong navy/gold premium HDE brand artifact.
Paid Telegram /start path from Phase 3/4 still requires human tester proof before broad launch.
